name: dsa_topk_transform_topk2048
description: sglang's DSA indexer top-k on HIP (sgl_kernel.fast_topk_transform_fused): each row selects the topk highest of its first lengths scores and writes their slots in the page_size=1 page table of its sequence, the cu_seqlens_q range holding the row; a row of at most topk scores writes all of its slots in order, then -1.

topk.description: Slots per row, 2048: all sglang's kernel takes.

lengths.description: Valid candidates per row, a prefix its page table covers.

page_table_size_1.description: Each sequence's slot of each candidate position, distinct within a row.

cu_seqlens_q.description: Each sequence's first row, then n_tokens.

out_page_indices.description: Selected slots; -1 after a short row's entries.
